pyplot: The collection of matplotlib's graph-drawing functions
plt: Uses matplotlib.pyplot under the short name plt
subplots: Makes the graph's sheet (fig) and the place to draw the graph (ax)
subplots.figsize: The sheet's size (width, height), in inches
figsize: The sheet's size (width, height), in inches
fig: The sheet for the whole graph (Figure)
ax: The place to draw one graph (Axes)
axes: Several places to draw graphs (Axes) side by side
plot.marker: The shape of the point marks ("o" is a circle)
plot.label: The name shown in the legend
marker: The shape of the point marks ("o" is a circle)
bins: The number of a histogram's bins
legend: Shows the legend (the list of line names)
tight_layout: Arranges things so the text does not overlap
show: Shows the graph on the screen
savefig: Saves the graph to an image file
rcParams: The dictionary of matplotlib settings (such as Japanese fonts)
edgecolor: The color of the edges of bars and points
seaborn: A library for statistical graphs, built on matplotlib
sns: Uses seaborn under the short name sns
pairplot: Lines up scatter plots of every pair of columns
hue: The column used to color by
